name: Wailing Caverns: Lord Serpentis's Fierce Blow follows Normal dungeon kit softening (#9297, #9344, #8917)
contract: Lord Serpentis (3673, Wailing Caverns map 43, Normal) casts the restored Ascension kit's Poison Bolt Storm (2102617, already registered in coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage) and Fierce Blow (975011, SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE, previously unregistered). Poison Bolt Storm from a level 28 caster already lands like Aku'mai's in Blackfathom Deeps (dungeon-normal-boss-kit-damage.json): 285 of 937.5 direct (0.304) plus a quarter-health area cap, proving CoADungeonNormal is boss-agnostic and already tunes this ability for Serpentis too, so #8917 is not a separate defect. Fierce Blow has no own low-level rank with a matching effect structure, so it is registered with normal_spell_id 0 and high 0.512 (Heroic / 1.66 * 0.85), the table's existing pattern for such spells: CoADungeonNormal::Factor() returns 0.512 unconditionally, then the single-target 40% max-health cap (CoA.DungeonNormal.TargetHitCapPct) applies. Measured on the module damage-taken hooks from a fixed 1000, as the Aku'mai scenario does.

steps.label: CONTROL: the group is in Wailing Caverns
#8917: Poison Bolt Storm from a level 28 Lord Serpentis already hits like Aku'mai's, same as Blackfathom Deeps
#8917: and its poison already ticks like the Normal rank's
No area hit from Poison Bolt Storm takes more than a quarter of a 1000 health healer
Fierce Blow now follows the Heroic / 1.66 * 0.85 Normal softening for a high-health target
Fierce Blow is additionally capped at 40% of a low-health target's maximum health
